label.zh: 企业经营数据分析专家

description.zh: 面向中小企业的经营数据分析。直接上传销售、采购、费用、库存、应收、预算等系统导出表或 Excel，自动整理和关联，回答赚了多少、利润为什么变了、钱花在哪里、钱压在哪里：指标体系搭建、利润变动桥、量价结构拆分、毛利与费用率、盈亏平衡、预算差异、应收账龄、呆滞库存、经营月报与看板。
description.en: Operating-data analysis for small and mid-sized businesses. Upload sales, purchasing, expense, inventory, receivables or budget exports; it joins and cleans them and explains profit changes, margins and expense ratios, break-even, budget variances, receivables aging, slow-moving stock, and builds KPI trees, monthly reports and dashboards.

welcome_message.zh: 把公司的经营数据表格发给我（销售、费用、库存、应收、预算都可以），说说你想弄清楚什么。
welcome_message.en: Send me your company's operating data (sales, expenses, inventory, receivables or budget) and tell me what you want to understand.

description.zh: 从上期利润到本期利润逐项拆解
description.en: Bridge last period's profit to this period's

prompt.zh: 请根据我上传的数据，拆解本月利润和上月相比为什么变化：收入、毛利率、各项费用分别影响了多少，用一张利润变动表列出来。
prompt.en: From the data I uploaded, explain why this month's profit differs from last month: how much came from revenue, margin and each expense line, in one profit bridge table.

description.zh: 哪个业务赚钱，费用花在哪里
description.en: What earns money and where costs go

prompt.zh: 请按产品（或业务线、客户）分析毛利和毛利率，找出不赚钱的部分；再按科目分析费用结构和费用率的变化。
prompt.en: Analyze gross margin by product (or business line or customer) and find what loses money; then analyze expense structure and expense ratios by account.

description.zh: 实际与预算的差异和原因

prompt.zh: 我上传了预算表和实际数据，请分析预算执行情况：哪些科目超支或没完成，差异多少，可能的原因是什么。
prompt.en: I uploaded the budget and actuals. Analyze budget execution: which lines are over or under, by how much, and the likely reasons.

description.zh: 逾期欠款和呆滞库存清单

prompt.zh: 请分析应收账款账龄，列出需要催收的客户；再分析库存，找出超过 90 天没有出库的呆滞库存，并估算一共占用了多少资金。
prompt.en: Age the receivables and list customers to chase; then find stock with no outbound movement for 90 days and estimate the cash tied up.

description.zh: 确定该看哪些指标及其口径

prompt.zh: 我们是一家（填写行业和主要业务）的企业，请帮我搭建一套经营指标体系：主指标、指标树拆解、每个指标的口径和数据来源，并标出用现有数据能算哪些。
prompt.en: We are a (industry and business) company. Build an operating KPI system: the main metric, a KPI tree, the definition and data source of each metric, and which ones our current data can compute.

description.zh: 收入、利润、现金和风险建议
description.en: Revenue, profit, cash, risks and actions

prompt.zh: 请根据上传的数据写一份经营月报：核心指标、利润变动原因、主要业务表现、资金情况、风险和建议，同时生成 Excel 汇总表和趋势图。
prompt.en: Write a monthly business report from the uploaded data: key numbers, why profit changed, business highlights, cash position, risks and actions, plus an Excel summary and trend charts.

zh: 每月3日「10:00」根据上月数据生成经营月报，附利润变动表
每周一「09:00」汇总上周收入、毛利和费用，与前一周对比
每月5日「10:00」对比预算与实际，列出超支最多的五个科目
每周三「16:00」更新应收账龄，列出逾期超过 30 天的客户
每月最后一个工作日「15:00」列出 90 天未出库的库存及金额
每季度首月10日「10:00」生成上季度经营分析，含毛利和费用率趋势
en: On the 3rd of each month at 10:00, write last month's business report with a profit bridge
Every Monday at 09:00, summarize last week's revenue, gross margin and expenses vs the week before
On the 5th of each month at 10:00, compare budget with actuals and list the five lines most over budget
Every Wednesday at 16:00, refresh receivables aging and list customers more than 30 days overdue
On the last business day of each month at 15:00, list stock with no outbound movement for 90 days and its value
On the 10th of the first month of each quarter at 10:00, write last quarter's review with margin and expense-ratio trends
